Oneliner

Remote sensing and 'AI' demonstration for Earth observation constellation.
Description

Remote sensing and 'AI' demonstration. Remote-sensing technology verification satellite jointly developed by SPACETY and ADASPACE. They are going to establish a global, minute-level updated Earth image data network consisting of 192 satellites. And this satellite is the first of its constellation, exploring a new range of commercial services.
